info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Fields API

params.name: updated.gt
params.description: Filter fields updated after this timestamp

items.docs:
Retrieves custom field definitions and their pick-list values for the organization.
Use the returned field ids with create-field-value and update-field-value when enriching core entities.

Defines a new custom field (text, number, pick list, etc.) that can be attached to supported Rillet entities for reporting and automation.
After creation, use create-field-value to seed allowed pick-list entries or default values teams should see in the UI.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the id to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Changes labels, validation rules, or visibility metadata on an existing custom field without recreating historical values.
Coordinate with stakeholders before renaming because downstream integrations often key off the human-readable label.

params.name: id
params.description: UUID of the id to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Adds a selectable value to a pick-list style custom field so users and APIs can tag entities with consistent taxonomy.
Values inherit the field’s scope, so create them after the parent field exists and before importing records that reference the new code.

params.name: fieldId
params.description: UUID of the field to be used in this operation.

params.name: fieldValueId
params.description: UUID of the fieldValue to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Renames or reorders a pick-list entry while preserving its underlying id so historical records stay linked to the same option.
Prefer this over delete-and-recreate when auditing requires stable references across reporting periods.

params.name: fieldId
params.description: UUID of the field to be used in this operation.

params.name: fieldValueId
params.description: UUID of the fieldValue to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Retires a pick-list option that should no longer be selectable while keeping older records intact for read-only history.
Confirm no automation or validation rules still require the value before removal to avoid breaking bulk imports.
